Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class SiteStats

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.SiteStats
public final class SiteStats extends Object
Per-site counters of what the browser's protections blocked, shown in the site-info popup: navigations blocked and popups blocked, keyed by host. The FxBrowser records a hit whenever the extension broker vetoes a navigation or a popup; the panel reads the counts for the current host.

Free of AWT/JavaFX and internally synchronised (the counters are written on the JavaFX thread and read on the EDT), so the logic is unit-tested headlessly.

      public SiteStats.Counts forUrl(String urlOrHost)
